note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: Read-Host 'Owner: episodes 1-2 are in DEV; the five test loans from demo.md exist (relative to today); App.Formulas has the UDF block, LoansScreen exists and BrowseScreen has the Open loans button; saved and published; an Outlook on the web draft window or a text editor is open for the paste. Press Enter'

screens.name: app-formulas
steps: Tree view: select App, property dropdown on Formulas, expand the formula editor: IsWorkingDay, WorkingDaysBetween and LoanState visible, no errors
Add a temporary label and type WorkingDaysBetween(Date(2026,11,27), Date(2026,12,9)): IntelliSense shows (start: Date, finish: Date) and the label shows 6
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: row-limit-overdue
steps: In Studio: Settings > General, Data row limit = 1
Preview LoansScreen with 'Overdue only' on: both CT-0043 and CT-0107 are listed
Show that galLoans has no delegation warning
Optional: paste the With version into galLoans.Items, show one row and still no warning, then undo

tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: open-loans
steps: Preview LoansScreen (phone layout) with the toggle off
Show the red 'N loans are overdue', four rows in due-date order with red/amber/grey colours, 'Charger missing' and 'No notes'
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar

screens.name: reminder-copied

Cut to the text editor or unsent Outlook draft window and paste the reminder (do not send)
